quests.title: Hawks Over the Rift
quests.description: The Rift is a day's walk of broken canyon between Camp Taurajo and everything south of it, and Brakka Stonehoof keeps the ramp that crosses it. Cliffhawks have started to nest in the walls. They don't mind the caravans. They mind the people on the ramp, who they see, quite reasonably, as dinner.
quests.accept_text: Brown wings, white throats, a lot of attitude. Thin them out along the canyon walls. Don't fall in. The Rift is not forgiving about that.
quests.turn_in_text: Quieter already. I can hear the wagons again. Take this. It's the least the Waystation owes you.

unique_item_defs.name: Waywarden's Cliff-Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Dun-coloured and weather-beaten. It disappears on a canyon wall, which is the point.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Ramp-Guard Spear
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Long enough to reach over a rail. Short enough to still stab someone.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Rimstone Tread-Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Ribbed soles. They grip rock like it owes them money.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Boots (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Geodes for the Warden
quests.description: The gravel skitterers of the Rift floor carry geodes in their shells like pockets. Brakka's wardens have learned that the crystals inside hum when a rockfall is about to happen. A string of them along the ramp would be worth a warden's life. They are, unhappily, worth a skitterer's too.
quests.accept_text: Glittering things inside the shell, you can't miss them. Six geodes. And if the skitterer objects, don't take it personally.
quests.turn_in_text: They hum! Listen to that. That's one fewer funeral this season. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Geode-Studded Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Leather bound with rock-crystal. They hum a little. They've never told anyone why.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Str/Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Warden's Rockfall Charm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A string of tiny geodes. It tinkles before a slide. The tinkle is the warning.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Canyon-Slate Shield
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A flat slab of slate, hand-fitted. Heavy, honest, impossible to leave behind.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

quests.title: Teeth in the Canyon
quests.description: The sabertooths came down out of the high rock three weeks ago. A caravan of kodo-haulers lost two animals and a driver on the ramp, and the survivors swear something bigger than a sabertooth watches from the ledges. Dustmaw. Brakka has heard the name before. She'd hoped it was a story.
quests.accept_text: Six cats first - they're the sure thing. Dustmaw, if he shows himself, is the reason. He's half the canyon's size and twice as stubborn.
quests.turn_in_text: Dustmaw. Dead. I'll hang a fang over the gate. You've earned a bigger share than that.

unique_item_defs.name: Sabertooth-Hide Jerkin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Spotted pelt over riveted leather. It still smells like the cat.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Dustmaw-Tooth Dirk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A fang as long as your hand, set in a wrapped grip. It still looks hungry.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Canyon-Warden's Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A plain band hammered from an old ramp-spike. It has held a lot of weight.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Across the Rift
quests.description: Two ramps cross the Rift besides the Waystation's, and Brakka hasn't had a warden near either since the cliffhawks started. She wants eyes on both. Walk the west ramp, walk the east one, and tell her what you see. The Rift is wider than it looks, and it is always quieter than it should be.
quests.accept_text: West ramp first, then east. Look for hawks, cats and anything that shouldn't be there. Bones are normal. Fresh bones are not.
quests.turn_in_text: Both ramps passable. Good. The Waystation can breathe. Take this - and remember me kindly when you cross.

unique_item_defs.name: Rimrunner's Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hide leggings with reinforced knees. For people who spend their lives climbing in and out of holes.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Legs (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Waystation Warhorn
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A small horn on a cord. One blast gets the whole ramp's attention.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Crossing-Keeper's Truncheon
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Short, heavy and well-balanced. Persuasive in a traffic dispute.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 1H (Str/Agi/Sta)

quests.title: Hyenas in the Bones
quests.description: Rurk collects bones. Giant bones, the kind that stick out of the Field of Giants like the ribs of a ship. Hyenas have made that harder. They've learned that a man with his arms full of bones is a man who cannot swing a spear, and they come in packs to prove it.
quests.accept_text: Spotted, patient, cheerful. Drive them off the bones. I'll make more of a living if I'm not being chased.
quests.turn_in_text: Mmm. Hear that? Nothing. You'd be surprised how nice that sounds. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Bonepicker's Padded Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Lots of pockets. Each one smells of something dead.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Hyena-Tooth Hatchet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A small axe with a hyena tooth set in the pommel. It's a lucky tooth. Mostly.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Marrow-Hardened Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Bone plates over mail. They've seen a lot of marrow.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Gloves (Str/Int)

quests.title: Giants' Knucklebones
quests.description: The old plain has more than bones. It has something that wears them. Dust-grey wraiths drift between the ribs, shouldering knuckles the size of anvils. Rurk wants those knuckles. Why? He won't say, and he pays well enough that you don't ask.
quests.accept_text: Bone-Dust Wraiths. They keep the knucklebones close, like a miser keeps coins. Take six. Don't let them take yours.
quests.turn_in_text: Six knucklebones. Look at the polish on that! Beautiful. Take this - I'll be busy carving.

unique_item_defs.name: Knucklebone-Linked Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Linked giant knuckle-plates. The belt weighs more than it should and holds up better than it looks.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Belt (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Carver's Bone Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A bone sliver carved with unfriendly little faces. They whisper when you aren't looking.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand

unique_item_defs.name: Giant's Memory Pendant
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A tiny polished knuckle on a cord. It feels like being very, very small.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Sta/Spi)

quests.title: The Matriarch's Last Walk
quests.description: A herd-mother kodo has been walking the Field of Giants in circles for a season, goring anything that wanders close. The herders call her Old Mother Longhorn. She isn't mad. She lost a calf, and she's been looking for it ever since. Rurk won't do it himself. He thinks it'd be bad luck. He pays well, though.
quests.accept_text: Six of her herd, the old and sorry ones. Then her. Be quick about it. She's been grieving long enough.
quests.turn_in_text: It's done, then. Quietly, I hope. Take this. And say a word for her at the gate, if you've got one.

unique_item_defs.name: Herd-Mother's Horn Helm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A horned helm shaped from a matriarch's horn. It's heavy, and it's warm, and it remembers.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Longhorn Calf-Cradle Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Soft hide, long fur. It looks like it's meant to hold something small.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak

unique_item_defs.name: Gorebreaker's Mace
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A hard, curved horn bound to a haft. Not made to be gentle.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 2H (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Thrumbone
quests.description: There is something in the Field of Giants that is older than the bones. The wraiths gather around it. It walks in a slow circle through the ribs, and the ground hums when it does. Rurk calls it Thrumbone. He's never seen it. He doesn't want to. He wants it gone.
quests.accept_text: Wraiths first. Then, if you feel the ground start to sing, you've found him. I'd run, but that's why you're being paid.
quests.turn_in_text: The ground's gone quiet. First time in years. I... thank you. Take these. They belong to the plain now, and so do you.

unique_item_defs.name: Wraith-Hunter's Marrow-Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A hollow giant femur, polished by a lot of wind. It sings if you hold it up to the sun.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff (Int/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Rattlebone Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Strings of small bones on cloth. They click in time with your heart.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Giantbone Breastplate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Sections of giant rib over iron. Bigger than it needs to be, tougher than it looks.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Sta)

quests.title: Skinner's Trophy Cords
quests.description: Oggra keeps the thornwatch on the Razorfen approach and has done for four winters. Razormane skinners wander south of the Ridge now, braiding trophy cords out of whatever they kill. Oggra wants the cords. Not for the trophies - for the names knotted into them.
quests.accept_text: Look for the small bell on the cord. That's how they know each other. Six cords. Bring them back and I'll read what they say.
quests.turn_in_text: Names. Faces. A lot of dead rangers. I'll write to their families. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Thornwatch Ranger's Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Boiled leather, sewn with thorn-wood buttons. Sharp edges, comfortable fit.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Ranger's Skinning Knife
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Narrow, curved, and extremely sharp. The grip is wrapped in a stranger's good intentions.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Trophy-Cord Choker
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A braided cord with a single small bell. It isn't there to warn you. It's there to remind you.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Str/Agi)

quests.title: The Boarhound Pack
quests.description: The Razormane keep boarhounds - low, bristled, built for charging through thorn. They've started to hunt in packs along the ridge, driven by a quilboar handler who is a lot better at it than Oggra would like. Hounds and handlers both.
quests.accept_text: Hounds to the west of the ridge, stalkers in the thorns behind them. Twelve in all. And if you find the handler, I'd like to hear about it.
quests.turn_in_text: Better. The ridge sounds different. I think I can hear the birds again. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Boarhound-Hide Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Tough bristled hide, hard to cut and harder to wear to a formal occasion.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Bracers (Agi/Spi)

unique_item_defs.name: Thornwatch Spear-Thrower
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A short bow of bent thornwood. It's light and fast. It hates being dropped.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Stalker-Cut Pauldrons
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail over leather with thorn-points riveted in. They make for a respectful hug.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Skinwalker Garn
quests.description: There's a story in the Ridge: a Razormane named Garn, who skins animals and wears what he takes. Oggra thought it was folklore until a ranger came back with half his coat missing. Garn works with seers, so Oggra wants the seers dealt with first.
quests.accept_text: Seers first, they're his eyes. Then Garn. Watch his hands - he can wear a face the way you'd wear a hat.
quests.turn_in_text: Garn's dead. The Ridge feels lighter. Take this - keep it close, and don't let anyone peel your coat.

unique_item_defs.name: Garn-Slayer's Patchwork Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hide in three colours. They look good, if you can ignore the stitching.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Legs (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Garn's Flensing Hook
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A curved blade for lifting pelts. It could also lift other things.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Many-Hide Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A cloak sewn from several different animals. Uncomfortably well-made.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: The Bramble Court
quests.description: South of Oggra's post the thorns grow thick and the quilboar thicker. A Bristleback matriarch, Durga, has taken the Razorfen approach for her court. She's grown her bramble-guard around her like a hedge. Oggra wants the hedge cut and the queen put in the ground.
quests.accept_text: Guards, then boars, then the queen. The thorns bite. The quilboar bite harder. Stay on the dry ground.
quests.turn_in_text: The Bramble Court is over. The approach is open. You've done more for the Barrens than a battalion. Take these.

unique_item_defs.name: Bramblequeen's Thorned Staff
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A staff of grown thorn. It's alive. It's a little offended.
unique_item_defs.label: Staff

unique_item_defs.name: Bramble-Court Hood
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A hood of woven vine. It sprouts small flowers when you cast something kind.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Helm (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Thornhide Warplate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plate studded with sharpened thorns. They didn't have to do that, but they did.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest

quests.title: The Pit at Bael Modan
quests.description: The dwarves at Bael Modan have been digging for years, and the pit keeps getting wider. Tarrik watches from the rim and has counted heads. Every month there are more miners and the hole is deeper. He'd like fewer miners. He'd like to find out why they're digging so fast.
quests.accept_text: Eight miners. They're not soldiers, but they swing a pick like they mean it. Thin them out and keep an eye on the pit. There's something at the bottom.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight down. And the pit's still going. They didn't even stop to look. That's what worries me. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Scout's Rimwalker Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thick-soled, quiet and easy to run in. A scout's best friend.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Quarry-Edge Short-Sword
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A short blade with a notch in it from hitting rock. Not a very good rock-breaker.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Dig-Watcher's Spyglass
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A tiny brass spyglass on a cord. You can see a surprising amount through it.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Golem Cores
quests.description: The dwarves have built golems to haul rock. Stone ones, grey and square, thumping up and down the terraces. They obey orders and never tire. Tarrik wants to know how. He'd settle for a piece of one.
quests.accept_text: Crack a golem. There's a core in the chest, glowing. Bring me five shards. Don't try to think about what they're running on.
quests.turn_in_text: Five. Interesting. They're running on... nothing. Or something that thinks it's nothing. I'll send word north. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Core-Shard Spellblade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A short blade set with a glowing shard. It hums when you cast.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword 1H (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Golemstone Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Stone-faced plate. They don't scrape. They crush.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Gloves (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Quarry-Dust Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Grey cloth, stiff with dust. It shakes off magic better than it shakes off dirt.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int)

quests.title: The Overseers
quests.description: Behind every dwarven digger is a man with a whip. The overseers keep the miners moving, and the engineers keep the overseers supplied. Tarrik thinks if he can break the middle of the chain, the rest will fall apart. He also thinks you're the person to do it.
quests.accept_text: Overseers wear red sashes. Engineers carry wrenches the size of your arm. Take both out and the pit's labour grinds to a halt.
quests.turn_in_text: The pit's gone quiet. Whole terraces idle. Nice work. There's one more thing to chase. Take this first.

unique_item_defs.name: Overseer's Brassbound Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Leather with brass studs. Good for crowd control and intimidation.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Engineer's Heavy Wrench
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A wrench you can break a skull with. It was designed for pipes.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 2H (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Rivet-Studded Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail links on a studded strap. It holds everything you own, and all of it rattles.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Belt (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Grubb's Ledger
quests.description: Foreman Grubb Deepdelver has run the pit since before the Keep was built. He keeps a ledger: ore, workers, accidents. Tarrik wants every page. A man who counts that carefully is a man who knows what he's counting for.
quests.accept_text: Pages from the overseers' satchels, and Grubb himself if he comes up for air. He's stubborn. He's also paid by the cubic yard.
quests.turn_in_text: Look at these numbers. They've been digging for something specific. I don't know what, but they know where. Take your reward. I'll write this up.

unique_item_defs.name: Quarry-Boss's Iron Cap
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A stout iron cap with a lantern-hook. Dented from every ceiling in the quarry.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Ledger-Keeper's Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cloth wraps stitched with a tally pattern. Counting suits you.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Quarry-Breaker's Pick
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A heavy pick with a short haft. It was used for digging, but it works for other things too.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe 1H (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Eyes on the Gate
quests.description: Zhuul lies in the grass east of Bael'dun Keep with a spyglass and a bad attitude. The dwarves have turned the keep into a proper fortress - riflemen on the walls, patrols in the yard. He needs someone to scout the gate and thin out the riflemen before they spot him.
quests.accept_text: Walk up to the gate. Look. Come back. If a rifleman objects, shoot him first. I'd go myself, but I'd leave a trail. Trolls are tall, mon.
quests.turn_in_text: Good. Good. Gate's guarded, but not as well as they think. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Spy's Silent Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Soft hide, dyed in the colours of dusk. It disappears in grass and in rumours.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Rifleman-Bane Crossbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light, quiet and fast to reload. It was built for one thing.
unique_item_defs.label: Crossbow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Gate-Watcher's Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A narrow band with a little peephole. You can almost see through it.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Mastiffs at the Gate
quests.description: The dwarves keep mastiffs at the Keep. Big, loud, mean and loyal. They've started to range out past the walls, and one of them found Zhuul's last lean-to. He'd like the dogs gone, and he'd like the dispatches they've been guarding. A hound isn't a good postman.
quests.accept_text: Mastiffs, and the sergeants that walk them. Sergeants carry dispatches. Bring me four. I don't read dwarvish, but I know a man who does.
quests.turn_in_text: Four dispatches. Orders for the east gate. The dwarves are digging in. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Mastiff-Tamer's Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Heavy mail with leather straps. Whatever you walk, it walks where you tell it.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Legs (Str/Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Dispatch-Runner's Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light, fast and quiet. It doesn't flap. It doesn't dare.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Keep-Hound Fang Dagger
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A fang set in a bone hilt. A trophy, and a warning.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: Cut the Fuse
quests.description: Bael'dun's explosives experts run a charge-line to the east gate. If it's fired, it'll bring the cliff down on the Waystation road. Zhuul wants the experts gone and the charges in his hands before that happens. He knows what he'll do with them.
quests.accept_text: Experts, with the little red hats. Take their charges, and don't drop them. I know that sounds obvious. It's not, if you've met a dwarf.
quests.turn_in_text: Five charges, all intact. I'm impressed. Don't tell anyone I said so. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Fuse-Cutter's Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thin leather, thick insulation. Made for people who do delicate work near explosives.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves

unique_item_defs.name: Sapper's Powder-Horn
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A brass horn on a chain. It never explodes. It threatens to.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Blast-Blackened Mail Hood
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Scorched mail with a leather liner. It remembers every explosion, and forgives none.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Helm (Agi/Spi)

quests.title: Sergeant Ironvein
quests.description: Sergeant Ironvein runs the Keep's east wall. He drills the riflemen, walks the mastiffs and hammers every plan flat. Zhuul says if Ironvein falls, the east gate falls. Zhuul has been wrong before, but he's very sure about this one.
quests.accept_text: Sergeants on the walls. Ironvein among them, if you listen for the hammer. Dwarves fight better in lines. Break the line.
quests.turn_in_text: Ironvein down. The east gate's lost its anchor. This is going to hurt them. Take this - you've earned it.

unique_item_defs.name: Ironvein's Gatekeeper Plate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thick dwarven plate with a vein of bright ore. It rings when struck, and holds.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Sergeant's Marching Axe
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A short axe built for crowded places. Fast, honest, and meaner than it looks.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Keep-Marcher's Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A band of dark iron. It looks heavy and feels reassuring.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Windspire Harpies
quests.description: The spires in the north-east are full of wind and voices. Harpies nest in the hollows, shrieking down at anyone who passes below. Alamir has hunted them for a season. Her arrows are running low and her patience's already gone.
quests.accept_text: Feathers, claws, a lot of noise. Eight of them, from the hollows on the east side. Don't stand under the spires. They drop things.
quests.turn_in_text: Quiet at last. You could almost hear yourself think. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Harpy-Feather Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Soft down and long flight feathers. It rustles when you aren't moving.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Shoulders (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Spire-Hunter's Shortbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A light bow cut for shooting at things overhead. It forgives mistakes.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Windcut Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail leggings with wind-cut slits. They breathe in the heat and still turn a blade.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Legs (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Voices in the Spires
quests.description: The wind sings through the hoodoo spires, and the harpy windcallers sing with it. Where they sing, the dust gets up and turns on you. Alamir wants the windcallers silenced and the crystals they carry brought to her. Crystals sing, too. They'd better do it for her than for the harpies.
quests.accept_text: Windcallers carry crystals, the size of your thumb. Dust devils follow the singing. Take the crystals, break the devils.
quests.turn_in_text: They're singing in my pocket. It's... not unpleasant. Take this, and stop humming.

unique_item_defs.name: Windcaller's Crystal Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A sliver of windspire crystal in a bone handle. It hums a tune you almost know.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand

unique_item_defs.name: Dust-Devil Wraps
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Fine cloth that eddies faintly in a still room. Unsettling and weirdly comforting.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Bracers (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Huntress's Spire-Cloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light, quiet and sand-coloured. A cloak for people who prefer not to be seen.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Skyshriek
quests.description: At the heart of the spires is a hollow where the wind never stops, and a harpy matron who has named herself for it. She commands the windcallers and sets the dust devils loose. Alamir wants her gone before the next storm.
quests.accept_text: The hollow is at the arch, near the east edge. Look for the biggest nest. She'll scream. Ignore it.
quests.turn_in_text: The wind's dropped. Listen. That's the quietest the spires have been in years. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Matron's Storm-Feather Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A long feather tipped with a spark. It crackles when you point it.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Spire-Weave Robes
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light cloth that doesn't catch on thorns or ideas.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Skyshriek-Talon Spear
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A long spear tipped with a harpy talon. It screams on release.
unique_item_defs.label: Polearm (Agi/Int)

quests.title: The Raptor Cull
quests.description: South of the spires lies the Raptor Grounds, a long valley between two ridges where the Sunscale raptors nest. Alamir is a hunter, and a hunter respects a cull. The grounds are overfull this season. Too many stalkers, too many lashtails, and not enough prey to go around.
quests.accept_text: Stalkers on the ridges, lashtails in the valley. Fourteen in all. Leave the eggs. I won't have it said I broke the balance.
quests.turn_in_text: Fourteen. Good. The valley can breathe. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Raptor-Scale Jerkin
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Overlapping scales over soft hide. It sheds sand and the occasional dagger.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Cullmaster's Longbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A strong longbow strung with raptor sinew. It remembers its prey.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Lashtail-Barbed Gloves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Gauntlets barbed with lashtail spines. Use caution when applauding.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Gloves (Str/Agi)

quests.title: Razorbeak the Nestbreaker
quests.description: A raptor alpha called Razorbeak has been raiding other nests - not for food, for eggs. She breaks them, one by one, and the grounds are going quiet for it. Alamir hates waste. She hates it more when it's deliberate.
quests.accept_text: Nest-mothers, four of them, protecting what's left. Then the alpha. She's fast. Don't stand still.
quests.turn_in_text: Razorbeak's gone. The nests will recover. Take this, with my thanks.

unique_item_defs.name: Nestwarden's Raptorbone Bow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Strung with sinew from the alpha herself. It twangs like something remembering how to hunt.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Nestbreaker's Scale Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Overlapping raptor scales over soft hide. It sheds sand and rumours.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Cloak of the Spared Egg
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Feathered and speckled. Smells faintly of gratitude.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Something Below
quests.description: Fizzwick Boltcog found the crater last spring and has been digging ever since. He found a stair at the bottom, a lot of glittering rock and, three days ago, what he describes as 'a series of unfortunate bites.' Sinkhole burrowers came up through the floor. They're still coming.
quests.accept_text: Little brown things, lots of legs, extremely rude. Thin them out and I'll get back to my digging. No, you can't see what I've found.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight! Marvellous. I've sorted three crates already. Don't look at them. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Excavator's Padded Coat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Thick hide with extra pockets. It smells of dirt and ambition.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Boltcog's Dig-Hammer
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A stout hammer with a pointed end. Good for rocks, locks and people who ask the wrong questions.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Burrower-Chitin Bracers
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plates of hardened shell, strapped over mail. They hurt anything that hurts them.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Bracers (Sta)

quests.title: Tunnel-Guards
quests.description: Below the burrowers are the tunnel-guards: bigger, harder, and a great deal better organised. They're keeping Fizzwick away from the stair, and he doesn't enjoy being kept away from anything. He'd like the guards dead, and a few of their chitin plates for his shop.
quests.accept_text: Six guards, five plates. They ring when you tap them, don't tap them. Whatever answers, you don't want to meet.
quests.turn_in_text: Five plates! They'll fetch a fortune in Ratchet. Don't tell my partner. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Tunnel-Guard Chitin Cuirass
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Layered chitin over plate. It rings when you hit it, and it hits back.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Brood-Slayer's Blade
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A long blade ground from a tunnel-guard's claw. The edge is chitin-fine.
unique_item_defs.label: Sword 2H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Shell-Plate Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Light chitin over cloth. Insects tend to leave you alone while you wear it.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Vexa the Tunnel-Queen
quests.description: At the bottom of the crater, past the guards, sits the queen. Her name is Vexa, and she has made the Sinkhole her own. The Broodspiral below is her nursery. Fizzwick wants to get to the stair, and, to be fair, he'd like the nursery safe. He just can't do either until she's gone.
quests.accept_text: Go down into the crater. Find the nest at the centre. She's big, she's angry and she will not stop. Neither should you.
quests.turn_in_text: The queen is dead. The stair's open. I'm going to need a bigger shovel. Take this, with my deepest thanks and a cheque I'll never cash.

unique_item_defs.name: Queen-Slayer's Brood-Mace
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A scepter of fused chitin with a pulsing sac at the tip. Do not squeeze it.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 1H

unique_item_defs.name: Tunnel-Slayer's Chitin Cowl
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Hard shell plates, stitched with sinew. The cavities hold amber, and the amber holds something.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Helm (Str/Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Hive-Amber Signet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A bead of resin, warm to the touch. Something small inside kicks whenever you heal.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring

quests.title: Down the Stairs
quests.description: The stair at the bottom of the crater doesn't go down so much as around. Fizzwick has measured it twice and gotten two different answers, which he finds deeply insulting. Drones and skulkers patrol the outer ring. Thin them out so he can chalk the walls.
quests.accept_text: Take the stair at the crater's edge and keep to the right-hand wall. It's a spiral. Stay with it and it'll bring you to the middle, whether you like it or not.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight drones, six skulkers. You came back with all your fingers. I'm adding that to my map. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Chalkmarker's Hive-Coat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Quilted hide, chalk-stained at the cuffs. Every pocket has a drawing of a tunnel in it.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Outer-Ring Spike
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A drone's barb on a hammer-handle. Gets the point across.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Stair-Walker's Amber Loop
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A little bead of resin on a wire. Warm, in a cold place.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Amber for the Taking
quests.description: The hive builds in amber, and amber, Fizzwick explains at length, is worth more by the ounce than any of the things he's dug up so far. Weavers and spitters carry the best shards in their glands. He'd like six. Don't ask what he does with them.
quests.accept_text: Hive Weavers spin it, Resin Spitters spit it. Either will do. Don't drop them. They go off, in a sense.
quests.turn_in_text: Six! Perfect clarity, and the one in the middle appears to be waving. Take this, I need to sit down.

unique_item_defs.name: Amber-Glass Cowl
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A cap of cloth with a lens of hive-amber. Everything you look at takes on a golden cast, and a faint resentment.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Helm (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Spitter-Hide Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Resin-hardened hide. Sticky only if you want them to be.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Fizzwick's Pocket Bulwark
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A tiny round shield of pressed amber. Very sturdy for something so small.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

quests.title: The Tenders
quests.description: Past the outer ring the tunnel widens into a brood chamber, and the things that tend it are called Brood Tenders. They are quite gentle. Fizzwick has been told this by someone who isn't coming back. The Broodkeeper sits at the head of the chamber. Kill the tenders; then kill it.
quests.accept_text: Six tenders, then the Broodkeeper. It sits behind a pair of resin pillars. Stay out of the green. The green is not for you.
quests.turn_in_text: The Broodkeeper's dead and the second ring's open. I'm very proud of you and also deeply afraid. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Keeper's Resin-Leggings
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cloth stiffened with brood-resin. It cracks when you kneel, which is a good reason to stay standing.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Legs

unique_item_defs.name: Tender-Plate Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Chitin over steel. Every plate remembers a different hive.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Gloves (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Brood-Chamber Thumper
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A carapace-headed mace. Hits like a tunnel collapsing.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 1H (Str/Sta)

quests.title: Screen the Queen
quests.description: The last ring before the Queen's Hollow is the Larval Screen: crushers, larvae, and a great pale guard who watches the throne from the dark. If Fizzwick's maps are right, the Queen sits on the other side. He'd rather you cleared the screen than found out how right his maps are.
quests.accept_text: Crushers first, then the Broodguard. It doesn't move much, and it hits like a falling roof. The Queen's behind it. Not today, though. Today you clear the screen.
quests.turn_in_text: The screen is down and you're alive. I'll chalk the throne room in on my next trip. Take this, with my gratitude and my apologies in advance.

unique_item_defs.name: Screenwarden's Crushing Axe
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A two-handed axe with a carapace-plate head. The Broodguard wore the blade first.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe 2H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Larval-Silk Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Pale silk, spun by something that should have been a moth. Cool to the touch.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Hollow-Edge Spaulders
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail laced with hive-amber. A faint glow when anything ugly gets close.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Shoulders (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Into the Kraul
quests.description: Every thorn on this ridge grows out of the same root, Oggra says, and the root is the Kraul: the quilboar hill-warren south of her post, with a mouth of bramble and a throat of boars. She has watched it for four winters and it has never looked as busy as this. She wants the gate guard thinned before anything else.
quests.accept_text: The gate is south of my post, under the thorns. Spearhides at the door, beast trainers just inside. Be quick, and keep your back to the wall. The wall is mostly thorn.
quests.turn_in_text: Eight spears, six whips, and all your fingers. You'll do. Take this. We're going deeper.

unique_item_defs.name: Thornwatch Scout's Vest
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Quilted hide with thorn-guards sewn into the shoulders. It smells of the hill and of Oggra's tobacco.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Bramble-Cutter
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A short hooked blade for cutting thorn, and, if need be, quilboar.
unique_item_defs.label: Axe 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Gatekeeper's Bone Ring
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A ring of carved bone. The Spearhide who owned it was no longer using it.
unique_item_defs.label: Ring (Int/Sta)

quests.title: Seed and Thorn
quests.description: The thorns on the ridge are not wild. The geomancers inside the Kraul seed them, one barbed pod at a time, and every pod is a little more hill the quilboar own. Oggra wants six seed-pods for her notes, and the geomancers who make them put in the ground.
quests.accept_text: Geomancers carry the pods, and they are almost always on the ground, working. Don't drop them. They go off, in a sense.
quests.turn_in_text: Six seed-pods. The thorn's spreading faster than I'd feared, and now I can prove it. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Geomancer's Thorn-Robe
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A robe stitched with living briar. Each thorn points away from the wearer, which is considerate.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Seedcaller's Wand
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A wand of dried seed-pod, still faintly warm. It clicks like an awakening plant.
unique_item_defs.label: Wand

unique_item_defs.name: Root-Bound Gauntlets
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Leather bound with root. They hold fast to whatever they grip.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Gloves (Str/Sta)

quests.title: The Vine Bridge
quests.description: West of the first fork a rope-and-vine bridge crosses a drop to a platform, and on the platform lives Roogug, who has been ordering the hill's warriors about since before Oggra was a ranger. He's off the main road, which makes him safe to leave alone. Oggra would rather he were not left alone.
quests.accept_text: The bridge is narrow. Don't fight on it. Wait for them on the platform, and Roogug will come to you. He's all muscle and no plan, so use that.
quests.turn_in_text: Roogug's down. The bridge is quiet, for the first time in my life. Take this, with my thanks.

unique_item_defs.name: Bridge-Warden's Vine-Hauberk
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Mail woven through with vine-rope. It creaks when you move and it dares you to climb something.
unique_item_defs.label: Mail Chest (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Roogug's Cudgel
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A knotted club with iron studs. It makes a distinct, regrettable sound.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 1H (Str/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Platform-Walker's Boots
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Soft leather boots, treaded for narrow places and falling.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Boots (Agi/Int)

quests.title: Two Speakers
quests.description: North of the fork the Kraul splits around the Thorn Court and two chieftains sit at either end of it. Aggem Thorncurse, west, who calls the boar-spirits; Death Speaker Jargba, east, who speaks for the dead and takes what they say very seriously. Both of them keep the hill's heartbeat. Stop either and it stumbles.
quests.accept_text: Both of them, in whichever order you like. Aggem's guards are beast-trainers with boars. Jargba's are Death's Head, with hexes. Don't fight both at once, and don't let either one finish a sentence.
quests.turn_in_text: Both of them! I'd call the hill's spirit broken, but I know better. Take this, and my respect.

unique_item_defs.name: Speaker's Hexbound Robes
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cloth sewn with thorn and prayer-beads. It hums quietly with other people's voices.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Chest (Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Boarspirit Greathelm
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A plate helm with a stylised boar-snout. The tusks are real, which is sad.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Helm (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Thorncurse Hunter's Bow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A bow of ironwood thorn. It pulls hard and seldom misses.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: The Pens Below
quests.description: At the centre of the Kraul is the Boar Pens: a corral ring, stalls on every side, and in the middle, Overlord Ramtusk, who has been fattening his boars for a war for a decade. Oggra wants the pens broken before they open them.
quests.accept_text: Sows in the stalls, the Overlord in the ring. The ring has three gaps. Hold the south one and they'll come to you. Keep the sows off your back.
quests.turn_in_text: The Overlord's down and the pens are empty. I'll sleep tonight. Take this, you've earned it.

unique_item_defs.name: Boarlord's Tusk-Plate
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plate grown over a pen-keeper's rib-guard. The tusk-spikes are decoration, mostly.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Chest

unique_item_defs.name: Pen-Breaker's Maul
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A two-handed maul with a boar's skull for a head. It hits like a collapsing corral.
unique_item_defs.label: Mace 2H (Str)

unique_item_defs.name: Overlord's Warcloak
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A heavy cloak of boar-hide. It rustles and whispers menacing little oaths.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloak (Int/Sta)

quests.title: The Beast Pit
quests.description: From the pens a narrow neck runs north-west, sealed by a ward and held by Ward-Keepers: the Beast Pit, where something called Agathelos has been fed on stolen kodo for years. The ward-stones keep it in. Take four and the ward falls, and then, Oggra says, you'll want to be ready.
quests.accept_text: Ward-Keepers hold the neck. Break the stones, then go in. Agathelos is a beast, not a boar. Don't mistake one for the other. It isn't kind.
quests.turn_in_text: Agathelos is dead and the pit's open to the sun. I hope that rattles Charlga. Take this.

unique_item_defs.name: Pit-Warden's Stoneward Shield
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A shield of warded stone. It still hums with the binding that held the beast.
unique_item_defs.label: Shield (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Beastcaller's Fang-Dagger
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A dagger carved from a beast-pit fang. It likes your hand.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Ward-Stone Pendant
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A seal-stone pendant, still faintly warm. It dulls the blows you take.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Sta/Spi)

quests.title: Razorflank
quests.description: At the top of the Kraul, on a platform of bones, sits Charlga Razorflank in a hut of thorn and tusk, and she has heard the pens fall, and the speakers die. Oggra says the hill's heart is hers. Take it, and the thorns will wither by spring.
quests.accept_text: Totemics around her, and she mends them as fast as you cut them. Go for her first if you can. The thorns won't forgive you, but they'll stop.
quests.turn_in_text: Charlga's dead. The Kraul will take a generation to recover, if it does, and the ridge will breathe. Take this, with all the thanks a ranger has.

unique_item_defs.name: Razorflank's Thornweave Mantle
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Cloth woven from living briar. It pulses faintly when something nearby needs healing.
unique_item_defs.label: Cloth Shoulders (Sta/Int)

unique_item_defs.name: Chieftain's Thorn-Guard Greaves
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Plate legguards edged with thorn. Enemies bleed before they have the sense to run.
unique_item_defs.label: Plate Legs (Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Agamaggan's Boarhide Belt
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A belt of ancient boar-hide, scarred and thick. It makes you feel hunted, and quick.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Belt (Str/Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Quilboar Queen's Longbow
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A great bow of quilboar-bone and sinew. It sings when strung.
unique_item_defs.label: Bow (Agi/Sta)

quests.title: The Blind Hunter
quests.description: There's a hunter in the western galleries of the Kraul who has been blind for years and still never misses. Oggra has lost two scouts to him. She wants him stopped, and the handlers that guide him dead.
quests.accept_text: West gallery, past Aggem's pen. He listens for you. Don't stand still. Don't breathe loudly, either, if it comes to that.
quests.turn_in_text: The hunter's down, and I'll write to the families. Take this, and my thanks.

unique_item_defs.name: Listener's Quiver-Coat
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: Soft leather, cut for quiet movement. It hushes the sound of your breath, and your boots.
unique_item_defs.label: Leather Chest (Agi/Sta)

unique_item_defs.name: Hunter's Blind Dagger
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A dagger with a handle wrapped in cord to find the grip by feel.
unique_item_defs.label: Dagger (Agi)

unique_item_defs.name: Handlers' Bone Amulet
unique_item_defs.flavor_text: A bone amulet, strung on sinew. It tingles when something nearby is lying.
unique_item_defs.label: Necklace (Int/Sta)

quests.title: The Road South
quests.description:
Wrangler Tull drove kodo down the Great Lift twice a year for most of his life. The Lift is gone and so is the cliff it hung on, and in their place is a mountain that has been there three years and will not be explained.

Taurajo has had no word from anything south of it since. Not from Freewind, not from the flats, not from the salt crews. Somebody has to walk up and look.
quests.accept_text:
Go up past where the Lift used to stand. You will know the spot - the winch house is still bolted to the rock and the cable runs out thirty feet and straight into granite.

Past that there is a seam in the ground where red dust stops and leaf mould starts, sharp as a knife cut. Stand on it and tell me what is on the far side. That is all. Do not go down anything yet.
quests.turn_in_text:
Trees. You are telling me there are trees.

I drove that road for twenty years. There was nothing up there but sky and a very long drop, and now you are telling me there are trees on it.

rewards.name: Wrong-Side Helm
rewards.flavor_text: Two kinds of dirt on it and no ground that makes both.
rewards.label: Mail Helm (Sta/Spi/HP)

rewards.name: Wrong-Side Fists
rewards.flavor_text: Two kinds of dirt on it and no ground that makes both.
rewards.label: Plate Gloves (Sta/Def/Dodge)

rewards.name: Wrong-Side Necklace
rewards.flavor_text: Found with one half in leaf mould and one half in Barrens clay.
rewards.label: Necklace (Int/Spi/HP)

quests.title: Whether Kodo Can Go Down
quests.description:
Wrangler Tull sent somebody up to the Lift once already and got back the word that there were trees on it. He has had three years to make peace with that and about four days to make peace with the rest.

There is a way down now. What he needs to know is whether it is a way down a kodo can take, because a road a kodo cannot walk is not a road, it is a footpath with ambitions.
quests.accept_text:
Walk the whole thing. Not the look-over-the-edge version - the whole thing, from where the timber quits down to where the road forks on the floor.

I am not asking about the view. I am asking about grade, footing and whether there is water in the first two days, and you will only know that by putting your own feet on it.
quests.turn_in_text:
Passable. You said passable, not good.

That is the first honest answer anyone has brought me about that country, and I have been asking for three years.

rewards.name: Redhoof Grips
rewards.flavor_text: Carried up a ramp, like everything else in this city.
rewards.label: Leather Gloves (Agi/Int/AP)

rewards.name: Needle-Cut Bracers
rewards.flavor_text: Hot to the touch until about two in the morning.
rewards.label: Mail Bracers (Sta/Spi/HP)

rewards.name: Sun-Scoured Hatchet
rewards.flavor_text: Carried up a ramp, like everything else in this city.
rewards.label: Axe (Dodge/Parry)
